money.name: 金钱
money.may_be_negative: Never: money stops at 0. A living cost that cannot be paid takes the money to 0; a class that cannot be paid for the whole period wastes the period

rep_rules.formula: sum of the road's three skill displayed values + rep_bonus
rep_rules.rep_bonus_rule: changed only by releases, annual events, opportunities and events

fame_rules.monthly_decay: if there was no exposure this month, fame -= max(1, fame*2/100)

long_contract.note: GDD 11.2 long contract: monthly pay; a few random roles per board are marked house roles and only those may be signed; house roles give the player's main color +n style points; after a refusal it returns a quarter later

drug.note: Step 12c c3 round 3 (GDD 5.8.1). The dealer is on the street by a roll at month start (dealer); a dose is a free action before any period (at most one per period). drug_points is the depth of the addiction (0 = not addicted), drug_stage follows it by stage_lines. All numbers are placeholders

dealer.note: probability = prob_pct + crime / crime_step x crime_add_pct (cap prob_cap_pct), + addicted_add_pct when addicted; each dose costs r(price) x (100 + price_depth_pct x depth)% (cap price_cap_pct)

attack.note: a month without a dose while addicted: every day fails with fail_base_pct + fail_step_pct x depth (cap); at month end fatigue + fatigue_base + fatigue_step x depth and depth - depth_drop

arrest.note: Step 12c. fine = max(fine_min, money x fine_pct%), never more than the money held (not below 0); the next detain_periods periods are void (detention)
arrest.raid_note: search probability of a crime job = prob x (1 + crime / raid_crime_div)
arrest.raid_check_note: Step 12c c3: when searched, r0(raid_skill displayed) + raid_check_add >= raid_line passes; otherwise arrest
